product_description:
Marvel Spidey And Amazing Friends Deluxe Poster Paint & Color - Phidal 

 

Grab your paints and crayons to get in on the action with the cast of Spidey and his Amazing Friends!

Our collection of deluxe poster paint with water coloring books combines story with art with full images and games to create the ultimate imagination-driven experience.

Use your paintbrush and crayons to add a personal touch to every page!

These paint with water activity books provide children with an opportunity to fully immerse themselves in the storybook world and help teach color recognition while improving hands-on skills and hand-eye coordination.

Ideal for road trips, airplane rides, rainy days and family travels while also a perfect gift for any occasion such as birthdays, holidays and and more! Suitable for Children aged 3+

Our spiral bound deluxe poster paint with water coloring books includes 80 pages of illustrations, 10 watercolor paints, a paint brush and 12 crayons.

Easy to use directions: Simply wet the paintbrush, moisten the paint palette, and fill in the pictures or pop out the crayons to color. The tear out pages showcase your little artist’s masterpieces in a snap!

Phidal Publishing has been the leader in children’s books, busy books, sticker books and more for over 20 years. We pride ourselves on top quality engaging books and games for children aged 3 and up. Choose from over hundreds of collections from our best selling busy books and little classics to our new sticker book treasuries!

Marvel Features:

  • ENGAGING ACTIVITIES for KIDS: Our deluxe poster helps teach children and kids color recognition while improving hands-on skills and hand-eye coordination!
  • FULL COLORING PAGES with BRUSH: includes 80 pages of illustrations, 10 watercolor paints, a paint brush and 12 crayons. Use your paintbrush and crayons to add a personal touch to every page.
  • PERFECT GIFT: For kids and children on holidays like Christmas, Easter, Valentine's Day, birthdays, and more!
  • SCREEN FREE FUN and PLAY: Perfect to enhance your child's creativity and artistic side with collaborative learning while reducing electronic device screen time!
  • EASY SETUP and TEAR: Easy setup with tear out pages that showcases your little artist’s masterpieces in a snap with portability and convenience.
